signal: LiveSwitch is a bootstrapped video API company (~$7.8M ARR, 71 employees) selling ultra-low-latency SDKs into telehealth, esports, virtual classrooms, and live commerce

email.body1:
Michael, been following LiveSwitch, bootstrapped to real scale on the back of your ultra-low-latency video SDKs across telehealth, esports, and live commerce.

Growing that lean usually means more in-market accounts than the team can work, and reps end up buried in research instead of conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for LiveSwitch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for LiveSwitch.

When you grow without outside capital, every rep hour counts, and most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and recovering a quarter gets expensive.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings LiveSwitch needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for LiveSwitch.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how LiveSwitch's reply rate likely compares to other developer-tools companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a lean team means time is tight, and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a lean SaaS motion? I will tailor it to LiveSwitch either way.
